searchInFiles.description: Index pages: show an "Also search inside files" switch beside the search box. On, the list query carries `_content_search=true` with a search term, and a row found through an attached file shows "Found in {file}". Default false.

entitySource.description: Name a registered NON-OBJECT entity collection for a type='index' page, instead of register+schema. Deliberately NOT called `source`: that key is already taken on page config and is polymorphic (a URL string in some manifests, an object with `params` in others), so reusing it would give one key two meanings and break six deployed shillinq pages. A flow definition is deliberately not an OpenRegister object, so an index had nothing to bind to and such lists became bespoke type='custom' pages. With a source the index loads the list itself. Takes precedence over register/schema; non-empty `objects` still wins over both. Registered sources live in src/composables/indexSources.js. `tasks` lists the viewer's task inbox from OpenRegister's flow-tasks read (cn-tasks-entity-source). `organisations` lists the OpenRegister organisations the viewer belongs to. On a type='detail' page a source that reads one record (today `organisations`) loads the record whose id is the route's objectId, instead of register+schema, and feeds the header, pills, widgets and @objectId / @object.* tokens like a fetched object (organisations-entity-source).

bulkBandAlways.description: type='index', board look: draw the bulk band (its actions and hint) before a selection too, its buttons disabled until rows are selected (DqZaken, DqWerkbord). Maps to CnIndexPage `bulkBandAlways`.

quickFilterPlacement.description: type='index': where the quick-filter chips sit. `toolbar` keeps them on one row with the Filter button and the view switch beside a side panel, the chips that do not fit behind the overflow chip (DqTeamwachtrij). `row` puts them on a row of their own above the toolbar, wrapping onto more lines. Maps to CnIndexPage `quickFilterPlacement`.

rowClass.description: type='index': per-row CSS class rules, compiled into the table's rowClass function as on the object-table widget. Each rule { when: { field, op?, value }, class } adds `class` to a row whose `field` (a dot-path) compares to `value` with `op` (default eq; the visibleWhen operators and tokens such as `@today`, with two dates compared as moments), e.g. an overdue task `{ when: { field: "dueAt", op: "lt", value: "@today" }, class: "cn-row--overdue" }`. Maps to CnIndexPage `rowClass`.

when.description: The predicate evaluated against the row (shared visibleWhen grammar, LOCAL form).

value.description: Literal right-hand side of the comparison.

class.description: CSS class added to the row when `when` holds.

sourceConfig.description: type='index' with `entitySource`: what the named source loads with. `endpoint`: `url` (an app path, required) and `rowsPath` (default `results`); its other keys go along as query parameters. `search`: `kinds` (`{ id, label, register, schema, titleField?, subtitleField?, statusField?, href?, limit? }` or `{ id, label, files: true }`), `term` and `termQuery` (default `q`). `users`: `defaultGroup`, `functionField`, `rolesField`. `flows` / `tasks`: `app`, `scope`. Maps to CnIndexPage `sourceConfig`.

limit.description: A paging source: rows per page (20 by default); the pager moves through the pages.

app.description: Scopes a named `entitySource` to one app (e.g. entitySource='flows' with app='dossiq' lists that app's flows).

contentField.description: type='wiki': property on the article object holding the markdown body. Defaults to 'body'. Maps to CnWikiPage `contentField` prop.

titleField.description: type='wiki': property on the article object holding the page title. Defaults to 'title'. Maps to CnWikiPage `titleField` prop. type='detail' (detail-title-field): the record field (a dotted path, for example `number`) the header names the record by, as an invoice page names the invoice number instead of the schema title; an empty value falls back to the display name, and the breadcrumb's current crumb and the type eyebrow follow. Maps to CnDetailPage `titleField`.

idParam.description: type='wiki': $route.params key holding the article id. Defaults to 'id'. Maps to CnWikiPage `idParam` prop.

treeField.description: type='wiki': property on each sidebar tree node holding its child array. Defaults to 'children'. Maps to CnWikiPage `treeField` prop.

sidebarTitleField.description: type='wiki': property on each sidebar tree node holding its label. Defaults to `titleField`. Maps to CnWikiPage `sidebarTitleField` prop.

sidebarRegister.description: type='wiki': register slug for the sidebar tree. Defaults to `register`. Maps to CnWikiPage `sidebarRegister` prop.

sidebarSchema.description: type='wiki': schema slug providing the sidebar tree. When set AND `tree` is non-empty the sidebar renders. Maps to CnWikiPage `sidebarSchema` prop.

emptyText.description: type='wiki': empty-state heading shown when the article is null. Maps to CnWikiPage `emptyText` prop.

emptyDescription.description: type='wiki': empty-state description shown when the article is null. Maps to CnWikiPage `emptyDescription` prop.

emptyBodyText.description: type='wiki': empty-body heading shown when the article has no content. Maps to CnWikiPage `emptyBodyText` prop.

emptyBodyDescription.description: type='wiki': empty-body description shown when the article has no content. Maps to CnWikiPage `emptyBodyDescription` prop.

cardComponent.description: Registry name for a custom card component on index pages. Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

sidebar.description: Sidebar configuration. For index: object with enabled, show, columnGroups[], facets, etc. For detail: boolean or object with show, enabled, register, schema, tabs[]. Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

show.description: Whether to show the sidebar on this page.

columnGroups.description: Index sidebar column-visibility groups. Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

tabs.description: Settings tabs (for type='settings'). Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

sidebarTabs.description: Sidebar tabs declaration for type='detail' pages. Each entry is the human-authored source of truth for one tab — `id` + `label` (required), optional `icon`, `order`, `component`. Widgets bound to a tab carry `tabGroup: "<tab-id>"` on `slot:"sidebar"` entries; cross-reference is validated. The CLI manifest-migrate transform lifts `config.sidebarTabs[].widgets[]` into top-level `widgets[]` with `slot:"sidebar"` + `tabGroup`; tab entries declaring only a `component` are carried forward as residual sidebarTabs[]. See src/cli/transforms/liftSidebarTabWidgets.js.

id.description: Unique tab identifier within the page. Referenced from widgets[].tabGroup.

label.description: i18n key (or literal) for the tab label.

icon.description: Optional icon name (CSS class or MDI identifier) shown next to the label.

order.description: Optional sort key for tab ordering; lower values render first.

component.description: Optional registry name for a full-tab custom component. When set, the tab renders that component directly instead of the per-tab widgets[] grouping. Resolved against the customComponents registry.

_note.description: Optional human note (e.g. lib-gap reason for an undecomposable tab).

sections.description: Settings sections (for type='settings'). Carry-forward from v1.3.0.

fields.description: Form fields (for type='form'). Carry-forward from v1.3.0. manifest-form-logic adds two OPTIONAL typed properties — `visibleWhen` (reuses `$defs/visibleWhen`; LOCAL mode resolves `field` as a dot-path into the live form data) and `validation` (`$defs/fieldValidation`) — while every other carry-forward field shape (`key`, `label`, `type`, `enum`, `widget`, `help`, etc.) stays untyped via `additionalProperties: true` on the item.

visibleWhen.description: manifest-form-logic: optional conditional-visibility predicate. LOCAL mode (neither `endpoint` nor `source`) resolves `field` as a dot-path into the live form data — the first dot-segment MUST match a declared `config.fields[].key` (validateManifestV2 post-schema check). `endpoint` / `source` modes keep their existing fail-safe, evaluated-once-at-mount semantics.

validation.description: manifest-form-logic: optional per-field validation rules, enforced client-side by CnFormPage before dispatch. See `$defs/fieldValidation` for the per-type semantics table.

steps.description: manifest-form-logic: for type='form' pages, ordered multi-step wizard groups. Each entry is `{ id, title, description?, fields[] }` where `fields[]` is an ordered array of KEY REFERENCES into `config.fields[].key` — steps do not embed field objects (config.fields[] stays the single source of truth). Absent `steps` = single-step form, byte-for-byte the pre-change rendering. When present, validateManifestV2() post-schema requires: step ids unique within the page, every fields[] entry references a declared field key, and every declared field key appears in EXACTLY ONE step (complete partition — an unassigned field would silently never render; a doubly-assigned field would double-render).

items.description: One wizard step. `fields[]` order is the rendering order for that step's fields.

id.description: Unique step identifier within the page's `steps[]` array.

title.description: i18n key (or literal) for the step's title, shown in the step indicator.

description.description: Optional i18n key (or literal) for a short step description/subtitle.

fields.description: Ordered field KEYS (referencing `config.fields[].key`) rendered on this step.

fieldWidgets.description: Declarative widget-component slots for type='form' / type='detail' pages. Each entry mounts a lib `Cn*` SFC inline (e.g. CnMarkdownEditor as a markdown field, CnSchemaSelect as a relation picker). Distinct from top-level pages[].widgets[] which uses widgetKey + grid coordinates against the host customComponents registry. Carries serialisable props only. See $defs/fieldWidget and ConductionNL/nextcloud-vue#314.

columns.description: Table columns (for type='index' and type='logs'). Items may be strings (legacy shorthand) or column objects ({ key, label, sortable?, width?, formatter?, formatterOptions?, widget?, widgetProps?, format?, aggregate?, colorMap? }). `colorMap` maps an enum column's raw values to a pill tone (default, primary, success, warning, error, info, purple, teal) and wins over the schema property's own `colorMap` / `x-color-map`. `formatter` resolves against cnFormatters (built-ins incl. currency / conditionalPhrase — configured via `formatterOptions`); `widget` resolves against cnCellWidgets (built-ins incl. badge / fkResolve / link / avatar / date).

folderSidebar.description: type='index': the opt-in folder navigation pane (CnFolderSidebar) rendered left of the list. Selecting a folder filters the list by `filterField` (or `field`); "All" clears it. Only the per-scope list-layout keys are typed here; the pane's own keys (source, register, schema, idField, nameField, folders, allLabel, title, allowCreate, ...) stay free-form. Maps to CnIndexPage `folderSidebar`.

scopeViews.description: The view modes (`table`, `list`, `cards`, `board`, ...) a scope's look applies in; in the others the page keeps its generic look while the scope still filters (DqWerkbord, 2.129.0).

heading.description: true heads the list with the selected folder's name, its parent folder and its count (always on a `groups` pane, 2.127.0).

countText.description: The count in that heading, `{count}` filled in, through the app's translate; a groups pane defaults to "{count} members" (2.127.0).

pane.description: false keeps the folder scope (a deep link such as `?caseType=<uuid>` still applies the scope's look and filter) without drawing the pane (dossiq's simple profile, 2.126.0).

folders.description: Explicit folder list for source:'custom', and the place a folder declares its own list layout. Every other folder key stays free-form.

layout.description: Dashboard layout entries (for type='dashboard', legacy). Carry-forward from v1.

content.description: Declarative content items for dashboard (widget-ref items). Carry-forward from v1.

widgets.description: Legacy dashboard widgets array in config (for type='dashboard'). In v2, prefer top-level pages[].widgets[] with the uniform widgetEntry shape. This legacy config.widgets key remains for back-compat.

stageField.description: type='detail': dot-path to the field holding the record's stage. Read by `primaryActionByStage` and `nextStep`.

primaryActionByStage.description: type='detail': the page's primary button per stage. Keys are values of `stageField` (matched exactly first, then ignoring case). A value is an action in the header action shape, or the id of a `headerActions` entry, which then leaves the overflow menu. A stage without an entry falls back to the page's `primaryAction`.

quickActions.description: type='detail': at most three always visible buttons in the header, for the actions a handler uses on every record. An item is an action in the header action shape, or the id of a `headerActions` entry, which then leaves the overflow menu.

actionsMenu.description: type='detail': what the header's overflow menu itself shows. Omitted, the menu keeps Refresh and the three help links.

showRefresh.description: false removes Refresh from the menu.

showHelpLinks.description: false removes Request a feature, Report a bug and Documentation, for an app that offers them in its own help menu.

showMarkUnread.description: false removes the built-in Mark as unread entry.

showOpenSidebar.description: false removes the built-in Open sidebar entry of the board look.

label.description: i18n key / text naming the menu, for example 'More'. Defaults to 'Actions'.

nextStep.description: type='detail': the 'what now' card above the body. For the record's stage it shows a short checklist next to the primary button. A stage without an entry shows no card. Rendered by CnNextStepCard.

field.description: Dot-path to the stage, when it differs from `stageField`.

stagesFrom.description: A field path, read like a `visibleWhen` field, whose value holds the stages in the `stages` shape, e.g. `@context.caseType.nextStep`, so each case type keeps its own stage texts and checklist. The declared `stages` apply otherwise (2.129.0).

title.description: i18n key / heading used by a stage that names none. May name record fields as `{path}` tokens; a list is candidates, the first whose fields all have a value is used.

i18n key / heading of the card for this stage. May name record fields as `{path}` tokens (`What now? Step 2: {statusPublicLabel|lower}`); a list is candidates, the first whose fields all have a value is used.

after.description: i18n key / one line under the button saying what follows. Takes `{path}` tokens and candidates as `title` does.

checklist.description: What this stage still needs. An empty list shows no card.

label.description: i18n key / text of the item.

hint.description: i18n key / short note after the label, for example '2 of 5 done'.

doneField.description: Dot-path on the record. The item is done when it holds a value; a list counts when it is not empty.

doneWhen.description: A local visibleWhen condition ({ field, op, value } or { all | any }). The item is done when it is true. Wins over `doneField`.

done.description: A fixed state, for an item the record cannot answer.

typePill.description: type='detail': a pill above the title saying what kind of record this is.

statusPill.description: type='detail': a pill above the title saying where the record stands.

sideColumn.description: type='detail': a column of cards beside the body, for the record's facts. An item is a widget definition, or the id of a widget declared on the page. The column stacks under the body on a narrow page.

tabs.description: The body tab ids this card shows beside; it is hidden while another tab is open (DqZaaktypeVelden, 2.129.0).

tabsFrom.description: type='detail': a field path, read like a `visibleWhen` field, whose value picks the tabs of the page's tabs widgets and their order for this record, e.g. `@context.caseType.tabs` (DqAanbesteding). A non-empty list of tab ids keeps those tabs in that order; otherwise the declared tabs stay, and edit mode shows them all (2.128.0).

sideColumnFrom.description: type='detail': a field path, read like a `visibleWhen` field, whose value picks the side column and its order for this record, e.g. `@context.caseType.sideCards` (a case type that names the cards its cases show). When the value is a non-empty list of widget ids, the side column is those of `sideColumn` in that order and the rest are left out; each still follows its own `visibleWhen`. Any other value, or no value, keeps `sideColumn` as declared. Maps to CnDetailPage `sideColumnFrom`.

headerActions.description: Page-level header actions rendered inside CnActionsBar's overflow dropdown (between the built-in Refresh action and the `#action-items` slot). On a `type:'detail'` page the same entries render in the header's Actions menu, above the Request-a-feature / Report-a-bug / Documentation trio. Same shape as the row-level `actions[]` ($ref action), but handlers receive NO row context — they are page-level. Reserved ids (`refresh`, `import`, `export`, `copy`, `delete`) are dropped at render time to avoid shadowing built-ins. An entry with `href` (instead of `handler`) renders as a real link to that URL and is never dispatched ($ref headerAction). See manifest-icons-and-page-actions for the dispatch semantics.

bulkActions.description: Bulk actions rendered in the contextual selection strip that appears while rows are selected. Same shape as the row-level `actions[]` ($ref action), but the handler receives the SELECTION rather than a row: `{ actionId, selectedIds, count }`. For `type: "open-modal"` the selection is merged into the modal's props as `selectedIds` and `count`, so a manifest-declared modal component can act on the selection without the page hand-writing anything. Reserved ids (`copy`, `delete`) are dropped at render time: the strip already ships both as built-ins. Before this existed the strip had only a `#selection-actions` slot, which only a hand-written host component could fill — so a page declared in a manifest could carry row actions and header actions but never a bulk one.

actions.description: Declarative actions on a page. An object entry is governed ONLY by "an object carrying a non-empty label", deliberately: this key is polymorphic by page type (index rows dispatch $defs/action; detail pages also carry type='lifecycle-transition' entries), so one closed grammar here would reject working manifests. A label is what every dialect needs — CnRowActions renders an entry from its label and icon, so an entry without one became a full-height, clickable, EMPTY row in the overflow menu. An object is always an app action whatever its id: an id, when present, must be a string that does not start with 'builtin:', and the object may not set a 'builtin' key. On a type='index' page an entry may also be one of the placeholders "builtin:view", "builtin:edit", "builtin:copy" or "builtin:delete", each at most once, which puts that built-in row action at its position in the menu. A placeholder only places a built-in: config.actionToggles / the show*Action keys still decide whether it renders. Enabled built-ins the array does not place are appended after everything else in the order View, Edit, Copy, Delete. Any other string (a bare "edit", an unknown "builtin:archive") is refused, and placeholders are refused on every page type other than index.

rowIndicators.description: type='index': state indicators the page declares for its rows. Each entry names a `field` (a dotted path on the row), a condition (`equals`, `in`, a date `after` or `before` a moment, or plain truthiness when none is given), an `icon` (a CnIcon name) and a `text` (the text alternative, required). An entry without `text` does not render, because an icon with no text is colour and shape alone. The page declares which indicators exist; a record cannot add one the page has not declared. Maps to CnIndexPage `rowIndicators`.

rowIndicatorCap.description: type='index': how many declared indicators render on the row itself before the rest move into the row menu. Maps to CnIndexPage `rowIndicatorCap`.

quickEditFields.description: type='index': the fields a quick edit asks for, opened from a row without leaving the list. The page names them; a record cannot open a form on a field the page did not name. A field this caller may not write (see `writableField`) renders read-only rather than missing. Maps to CnIndexPage `quickEditFields`.

writableField.description: type='index': the dotted path where a record lists the fields this caller may write. A row carrying nothing there leaves every field the quick edit named editable; an empty list is a refusal and locks them all. Maps to CnIndexPage `writableField`.

viewTabs.description: type='index': saved view ids this page renders as tabs instead of as entries in the views control. A view appears in one place or the other, never both. An id naming a view that no longer exists produces no tab, rather than a tab that opens nothing. Maps to CnIndexPage `viewTabs`.

viewCounts.description: type='index': which saved views show how many records they match. `true` counts every saved view (tabs and the entries in the views control), an array counts only the view ids it lists. Off by default, so no count request is made. Quick filters opt in per entry with `showCount: true`. Maps to CnIndexPage `viewCounts`.

priorityField.description: type='index': the field carrying a record's DERIVED priority. The list reads the value and sorts on it; it never computes one. A record with no priority, or one outside `priorityLevels`, sorts after every ranked record in BOTH directions and stays in the list. Maps to CnIndexPage `priorityField`.

priorityLevels.description: type='index': the priority values in rank order, lowest first (e.g. ['low', 'medium', 'high']). Needed because a priority does not sort alphabetically into the order a person means. Maps to CnIndexPage `priorityLevels`.

listShortcuts.description: type='index': offer the list's keyboard shortcuts. Every shortcut is also listed in the command palette and on the help key, from one catalogue, because a shortcut nobody can find does not count. Maps to CnIndexPage `listShortcuts`.

rowActionField.description: type='index': the dotted path on each row where the server lists the actions this caller may run on that record (default '@self.actions'). A row's menu is then the intersection of what `config.actions` declares and what the server allows: an action the server allows but the page does not declare stays out, and an action the page declares but the server refuses stays out with its reason kept. A row carrying nothing at this path leaves the declaration standing. Maps to CnIndexPage `rowActionField`.

editOpensDetail.description: type='index': send the Edit row action to the record's detail page instead of opening the edit modal. OPT-IN — CnPageRenderer used to set this wherever a type='detail' page or config.rowRoute existed, and it no longer does: @edit-open is bound to the same navigation as a row click, so a routed Edit just repeats the row click (the split pane, or the detail page) and the form is no longer reachable from the list. Declare true per page when the modal cannot express the record. Maps to CnIndexPage `editOpensDetail`.

showEditAction.description: type='detail': show the header Edit button that opens the record's schema form. Set automatically by CnPageRenderer for every schema-bound detail page; declare false to make a detail page read-only. Maps to CnDetailPage `showEditAction`.

formSize.description: NcDialog size for the page's built-in Add/Edit form dialog (type='index' and type='detail'). A manifest `open-form` header action has always been able to ask for `large`; the built-in dialog could not, so the same app could have a roomy create form on one surface and a cramped one on another. Maps to CnIndexPage / CnDetailPage `formSize`.

formColumns.description: How many columns the page's built-in Add/Edit form flows its fields into. Pair 2 with formSize 'large', or the two columns are merely two narrow ones. CnFormDialog collapses back to one column below 700px, and a textarea or JSON editor spans both columns regardless. Maps to CnIndexPage / CnDetailPage `formColumns`.

excludeFields.description: Property names kept OUT of the page's built-in Add/Edit form dialog. Maps to CnIndexPage / CnDetailPage `excludeFields`.

includeFields.description: Property names the page's built-in Add/Edit form dialog shows, in this order — a whitelist, so anything absent is hidden regardless of excludeFields. Maps to CnIndexPage / CnDetailPage `includeFields`.

fieldOverrides.description: Per-field overrides merged over the schema-derived field descriptors in the page's built-in Add/Edit form dialog (e.g. `{ "description": { "widget": "textarea" } }`). Which widget a field renders as belongs to the surface, not to the schema. Maps to CnIndexPage / CnDetailPage `fieldOverrides`.

createDefaults.description: type='index': seed values for the page's built-in create dialog, never applied on edit. Resolves `@me`/`@now`/`@today` at any depth; `@object.*`/`@workspace.*`/`@config.*` need a context the page does not carry and pass through unchanged. Maps to CnIndexPage `createDefaults`.

createSuccessRoute.description: type='index': route opened after a successful create from the page's built-in Add dialog; the created object's id is merged into the params. Maps to CnIndexPage `createSuccessRoute`.

createSuccessMessage.description: type='index': toast shown after a successful create from the page's built-in Add dialog. Maps to CnIndexPage `createSuccessMessage`.

savedViewsScope.description: type='index': which pages share this page's saved views. By default a view is shared by every page over the same register and schema and by no other, because a view is filters over one schema's fields. Set this to share views across pages over different sources, or to keep two pages over one source apart. Written into the saved view's `query.scope`; views saved before scoping stay visible everywhere. Maps to CnIndexPage `savedViewsScope`.

defaultSavedViews.description: type='index': views the app ships for this page. Listed read-only above each user's own saved views, under Default views, and never stored: a new app version updates them for everybody and no user can delete one. A user may apply a default or save a copy, which they then own. `@`-tokens in `filters` (`@me`, `@today`, `@today+7d`) resolve when the default is applied; a copy keeps them. Maps to CnIndexPage `defaultSavedViews`.

slug.description: The stable name of the default. Lowercase and dash only.

name.description: What the filter is called in the control. Translatable.

filters.description: The filters, keyed by property, in the shape a quick filter's `filter` takes.

search.description: A search term the default applies.

label.description: One label for the control's label filter.

icon.description: pill-color-field: a registered icon name the view's My views menu entry shows instead of the filter icon (a case type's own icon, say).

overrides.description: Page config this view lays over the page while it is active; leaving the view restores the page. Each key is optional and, apart from `header`, the aliases `tabs` and `views`, `sortOption`, `slots` and `badge`, takes the shape of the page config key of the same name. A saved view carries the same object in `query.overrides`, so a copy of a default keeps it (saved-view-overrides, 2.132.0).

pageTabs.description: Tabs to sibling pages or views, `countFrom` included. Same as config.pageTabs.

viewModes.description: The view modes the toggle offers. Same as config.viewModes.

viewMode.description: The view mode the view opens in. Same as config.viewMode.

folderSidebar.description: `null` hides the folder sidebar. Same as config.folderSidebar.

header.description: Groups header keys; a key spelled out beside it wins.

lockedFilters.description: Base filters added to the page's `filter` while the view is active, which the reader cannot clear, as the old Queue and Assigned to me pages had (2.132.0).

sortOption.description: The `value` of a `sortSelectOptions` entry to select, an endpoint-sourced one included.

slots.description: Named page slots (`below-header`, `before-collection`, ...) mapped to a registry component or a list of them drawn in order, laid over the page's `slots`; `null` or `[]` empties that slot.

badge.description: A count on the view's menu entry, in a menu entry's terms. `true`, or `count: true`, counts the view's own list: the page's register, schema and base filter with the view's filters. A `count` object may name another `register`, `schema` or `filter`. `counterVariant: attention` draws the attention pill.

splitCloseButton.description: type='index': whether the split pane draws its own close link. Set false when a `#split-pane` slot draws one from the slot's `close`. Maps to CnIndexPage `splitCloseButton`.

splitCloseLabel.description: type='index': accessible name and tooltip for the split pane's close button. Defaults to "Close". Maps to CnIndexPage `splitCloseLabel`.

look.description: screens-chrome-parity: draw this page in the `nextcloud` or the `board` look, over the manifest's root `look`. The nearest value wins: the page root carries `cn-look-board` or `cn-look-nextcloud`, and `cnLook` is re-provided to the page's descendants.

saveMode.description: type='settings' (screens-chrome-parity): where the page saves. `section` ends each section that has fields in its own Save button and draws no page save bar. `page` draws one Save as the last header button and a Changes card listing the changed fields; no section draws a save button. Absent, the page keeps the save bar under the last section. Cannot be combined with `autosave` or with a section that declares its own `save`. Maps to CnSettingsPage `saveMode`.

autosave.description: type='settings' (screens-chrome-parity): the page saves on change. It draws no save button and its description ends with "Changes are saved automatically." Cannot be combined with `saveMode`. Maps to CnSettingsPage `autosave`.

showHeader.description: type='dashboard': `false` drops the header row (title, description, header actions, edit toggle) for a page that opens with its own heading, such as a greeting widget; the title stays as a visually hidden heading (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps). Maps to CnDashboardPage `showHeader`.

views.description: type='dashboard' | type='detail': views of the page, each its own widget grid behind one segmented control ("My work | My team") (view-switch-containers). The chosen view renders in a region below the page's own grid, drawn with the same grid and widgets; the page's own `widgets` and `layout` stay above it. The switch sits in the page header, or in a greeting header widget whose `content.views.options[]` carry `view` instead of `route`. The chosen view is in the address (`?view=<id>`) and in the user's preferences; the address wins. A view with nothing to draw shows `emptyText`, else a default sentence. On a detail page, views replace the automatic Data and Related body. Maps to CnDashboardPage / CnDetailPage `views`.

id.description: The view id, written to the address as `?view=<id>`.

label.description: The option label and the region's accessible name (through the app's translations).

title.description: type='dashboard': the page title while this view is open, e.g. "My team" (through the app's translations; view-title, 2.119.0). Without it the page keeps its own title.

icon.description: Optional MDI icon name, reserved for an icon-bearing switch.

emptyText.description: The sentence shown when the view has nothing to draw.

widgets.description: The view's widget definitions, the same shape as the page's `widgets`.

layout.description: The view's grid layout, the same shape as the page's `layout`.

defaultView.description: type='dashboard' | type='detail': the id of the view chosen when neither the address nor the user's stored choice names one; without it the first view (view-switch-containers). Maps to `defaultView`.

viewsLabel.description: type='dashboard' | type='detail': the accessible name of the page's view switch, e.g. "Whose work"; defaults to "View" (view-switch-containers). Maps to `viewsLabel`.

headerMeta.description: type='detail', board look: the meta line on row 2 of the header, after the breadcrumb and a middle dot (screens-detail-page-parity). A field template such as `"via {channel}"`: every `{path}` is read from the record, and a line with an empty value is dropped. Maps to CnDetailPage `headerMeta`. type='index' | 'dashboard' | 'settings' (page-header-breadcrumb): the note after the breadcrumb and a middle dot under the title; on an index page `{total}` and `{shown}` are the list's counts.

headerMetaCounts.description: type='index': the other lists headerMeta counts, by name. Each is read as one list total and fills `{count:<name>}` in headerMeta ("{total} contracten bij {count:suppliers} leveranciers"); while a count loads or when it fails, the note is left out.

tabsLabel.description: type='detail', board look: the accessible name of the tab list, for example "Case parts". Defaults to "<type> parts" from the page title (screens-detail-page-parity). Maps to CnDetailPage `tabsLabel`.

identifierField.description: type='detail', board look: the record field (a dotted path, for example `identifier`) that names the record in the last line of the side column's History card (screens-detail-page-parity). Maps to CnDetailPage `identifierField`.

showWidgetActions.description: type='dashboard' and type='detail': `false` drops the overflow Actions menu from every widget that does not set `showActions` itself, for a dashboard whose widget headers carry a header link and nothing else (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps-2), or a record page whose data cards carry none (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps-3; a card with an Add action keeps it). When the key is not set a detail page keeps the menu, except under the board look, where side cards carry none (screens-detail-page-parity). Maps to CnDashboardPage / CnDetailPage `showWidgetActions`.

pageFilters.description: type='dashboard': page-level filter controls in the header. Each selection is written into the page's workspace context, so a widget reads it through a `@page.<key>` / `@workspace.<key>` token (an endpoint widget also in its `responsePath`). Maps to the CnDashboardPage `pageFilters` prop.

key.description: Workspace-context key written on change (the `@page.<key>` / `@workspace.<key>` token name).

label.description: Control label (i18n key or plain text).

type.description: Control type, carried over from v1.

control.description: How the filter is drawn: a select, or a compact segmented group.

clearable.description: Lets the reader clear the select back to all; `placeholder` names that state (2.130.0).

placeholder.description: What a cleared select shows, e.g. "All case types", through the app's translate (2.130.0).

optionsFrom.description: Read the options instead of listing them: from an app endpoint (`url`, `params`, `responsePath`) or from OpenRegister objects (`register`, `schema`, `filter`). `valueField` and `labelField` pick each option's value and label (default `id` and `title` or `name`); tokens resolve (2.130.0).

placement.description: Where the filter sits: in the header's filter row, or (a segmented group) on the description line after the period group (DqProcesanalyse).

default.description: Initial value seeded into the context on mount; the first option's value when omitted.

value.description: Value written into the context when picked.

label.description: Display text (i18n key or plain text).

kpiRow.description: type='dashboard': widget ids drawn as a KPI row above the grid, in the listed order, in an auto-fit grid (`repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))`, gap 16). The named widgets are not GridStack items, so they do not reflow with the grid and are not part of the emitted layout; an id that names no widget is skipped with a development warning (screens-dashboard-parity). Maps to CnDashboardPage `kpiRow`. `dateRange.control` also accepts "segmented": the presets as one compact segmented group under the header.

label.description: i18n key drawn where the greeting would be.

greeting.description: type='dashboard': greet the reader in the header subtitle. `true` or "first" writes "Good afternoon, Pieter · Monday 5 October 2026", "full" uses the whole display name; the page `description` follows after another middle dot (screens-dashboard-greeting-header). Since 2.111.0 "date" leads with the date alone ("Tuesday 7 October 2026 · ...") and `{ "label": "Customer contact" }` puts the translated label where the greeting would be (dashboard-greeting-label). Maps to CnDashboardPage `greeting`.

viewLinks.description: type='dashboard': links drawn as small pills on the switch row under the header, right of the view switch (screens-dashboard-greeting-header). `route` is a route name or a `{ name, params, query }` location, `href` a plain URL; `label` is an i18n key. An entry without a label or a target is skipped. Maps to CnDashboardPage `viewLinks`.

showActionsMenu.description: type='dashboard': `false` removes the page Actions menu from the header, for a board page whose header carries only the buildiq square and the primary (screens-dashboard-greeting-header). Maps to CnDashboardPage `showActionsMenu`.

gridFloat.description: type='dashboard': `false` packs widgets upward (GridStack `float: false`), so a size-to-content widget that shrinks closes the gap under it instead of leaving an empty band (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps-3). Maps to CnDashboardPage `gridFloat`.

showTitle.description: type='index': show the page header (icon, title, description) inline. Default false: the title renders visually hidden and the sidebar names the page. Maps to CnIndexPage `showTitle`.

singular.description: i18n key of the line for a total of one, e.g. "{total} invoice".

plural.description: i18n key of the line for any other total, e.g. "{total} invoices".

countSubtitle.description: type='index': an i18n key for the description line with `{total}` replaced by the collection's total, e.g. "{total} open cases" (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps). Shown in place of `description` once a total is known. `{ singular, plural }` picks the form by the total through the app's plural translation (`translatePlural`), so "1 factuur" and "12 facturen" each read right (index-count-plural). Maps to CnIndexPage `countSubtitle`.

showTitleIcon.description: type='index': `false` drops the icon before the page title, for a title that stands alone as the board draws it (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps-3). Maps to CnIndexPage `showTitleIcon`.

showCount.description: type='index': `false` drops the actions bar's "Showing 20 of 258" line, for a page whose title line already gives the total through `countSubtitle` (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps-3). Maps to CnIndexPage `showCount`.

countText.description: type='index', board look: the count line under the title, a template with `{shown}` (rows on this page), `{total}` (all rows) and free text, e.g. "{shown} of {total} open cases in your teams"; defaults to `countSubtitle`, else "{shown} of {total}" (screens-index-list-parity). Maps to CnIndexPage `countText`.

footerNote.description: type='index', board look: free text after the footer's count, e.g. "click a column header to sort" (screens-index-list-parity). Maps to CnIndexPage `footerNote`.

queryPresets.description: type='index': per-query overlays of this page (screens-index-query-presets). A menu entry that deep-links here with a query (`menu[].query`, e.g. { caseType: '<uuid>' }, the shape hydra gate-68 asks for instead of a second page) gets its own lenses, columns and copy: the first preset whose every `match` pair is in the route query replaces those keys of this config. Only the listed keys can be replaced; register, schema and permissions stay the page's. Switching preset remounts the list.

id.description: A name for the preset, for people reading the manifest.

match.description: Route query pairs that must ALL be present, e.g. { "caseType": "<uuid>" }. A repeated parameter matches when it holds the value.

title.description: The page title while the preset applies.

quickFilters.description: The lenses while the preset applies; same shape as config.quickFilters.

columns.description: The columns while the preset applies; same shape as config.columns.

cardFields.description: The card facts while the preset applies.

countText.description: The count line while the preset applies.

searchPlaceholder.description: The search placeholder while the preset applies.

footerNote.description: The footer note while the preset applies.

defaultSort.description: The default sort while the preset applies; same shape as config.defaultSort.

viewSwitch.description: The drawn view segments while the preset applies.

addLabel.description: The add button label while the preset applies (index-scope-presentation).

headerButtons.description: The header buttons while the preset applies; same shape as config.headerButtons (index-scope-presentation).

breadcrumb.description: The breadcrumb while the preset applies; same shape as config.breadcrumb (index-scope-presentation).

headerMeta.description: The note after the breadcrumb while the preset applies (index-scope-presentation).

afterList.description: The cards after the list while the preset applies; same shape as config.afterList (index-scope-presentation).

viewSwitch.description: type='index', board look: the segments the view switch draws, e.g. ["table", "cards", "board", "map"] as the boards do. A listed mode the page can open is an ordinary segment; one it cannot (no board columns, no map) is drawn disabled and named "<mode>: not available on this list". Order is always table, cards, board, map. Ignored without the board look (screens-view-switch-parity). Maps to CnIndexPage `viewSwitch`.

filterStrip.description: type='index': a second filter strip under the toolbar, on one field (board PqWachtrij: the kind in the quick filters, the channel in this strip). "All" and one pill per value (`options`, else the field's schema enum); picking one filters the list on that value, All clears it. With `showCount` each pill counts its rows within the active quick filter (screens-filter-strip, 2.92.0). Maps to CnIndexPage `filterStrip`.

label.description: The strip's accessible name; default the field's title.

viewSwitchLinks.description: type='index', board look: view switch segments that open another PAGE instead of switching in place, by mode: `{ "board": { "route": "CaseBoard" } }` for a board or a map that is a page of its own. The segment sits in its place in the switch (table, cards, board, map) as a link: `route` with optional `params` and `query`, or `href`. A mode the page opens in place stays a button, and a route the router cannot resolve is left out. Ignored without the board look (screens-view-switch-links, 2.91.0). Maps to CnIndexPage `viewSwitchLinks`.

searchPlaceholder.description: type='index': the placeholder (and accessible name) of the list's search field, e.g. "Search by case, number or requester". Run through the app's translate, so an English key with a Dutch catalogue entry reads Dutch. Absent: the library's "Search…" (screens-index-toolbar-parity). Maps to CnIndexPage `searchPlaceholder`.

bulkHint.description: type='index', board look: the 13px hint after the bulk band's buttons (screens-index-list-parity). Maps to CnIndexPage `bulkHint`.

cardFields.description: type='index': the property keys the cards view shows as the facts list of each card, in order; defaults to the first four list columns under the board look (screens-card-parity). Maps to CnIndexPage `cardFields`.

cardLayout.description: type='index', board look: the record layout of each card in the cards view (board-record-card-layout): a pill and the number on the head row, the title, a meta line, and a footer with a pill and a date. Each part names a field (a dot path) and is left out while it is empty; a pill maps values to a badge variant (`colorMap`, ignoring case) and to shown text (`labels`). Maps to CnIndexPage `cardLayout`.

resolve.description: pill-color-field: the field holds the id of a record; the pill takes the tone that record's colour maps onto and shows its icon. Register and schema default to the field's reference.

due.description: Read the field as a due date: overdue gives the error variant, within `soonWithin` days the warning one; any other date draws no pill.

variantWhen.description: Rules on the days left until the field's date, `{ op, value, variant }`; the first match gives the variant, no match draws no pill.

meta.description: The meta line's parts: a field name reads through the page column it names; `{ field, formatter?, formatterOptions? }` reads as plain text through its own formatter (card-layout-part-formatter).

resolve.description: pill-color-field: the field holds the id of a record; the pill takes the tone that record's colour maps onto and shows its icon. Register and schema default to the field's reference.

due.description: Read the field as a due date: overdue gives the error variant, within `soonWithin` days the warning one; any other date draws no pill.

variantWhen.description: Rules on the days left until the field's date, `{ op, value, variant }`; the first match gives the variant, no match draws no pill.

overdueVariant.description: The date's tone once it has passed (2.132.0).

description.description: A line under the meta line: a field, or `{ field, maxLength? }` cut at maxLength characters (140 by default) with an ellipsis (2.132.0).

chips.description: Pills under the description, one per entry whose field holds a value; the text reads through the entry's formatter, `colorMap` and `labels` work as on a pill (2.132.0).

resolve.description: pill-color-field: the field holds the id of a record; the pill takes the tone that record's colour maps onto and shows its icon. Register and schema default to the field's reference.

afterList.description: type='index': cards after the list, stacked full width in the listed order, the counterpart of statRow above it (index-scope-presentation). Each entry is a widget definition resolved like statRow's. A query preset or a folder scope can set its own. Maps to CnIndexPage `afterList`.

statRow.description: type='index': KPI tiles above the list, between the header and the toolbar, in an auto-fit row (each at least 200px). Each entry is a widget definition, usually `type: "stat"`; the type resolves through the app's widget registry, then the dashboard catalog (screens-index-stat-row). Maps to CnIndexPage `statRow`.

sidePanel.description: type='index': titled cards in a 300px column right of the toolbar and the list (above them below 1024px). Each entry is a widget definition with an optional `title` (i18n key) and `headerLink`; the type resolves as for `statRow` (screens-index-stat-row). Maps to CnIndexPage `sidePanel`.

headerButtons.description: type='index': buttons beside the page title, as the board's "Export" and "New case" (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps-3). `action` is `add` (the Add flow; the label defaults to the Add label), `export` (the export leaf in `format`, else the export dialog; under the board look it reads "Download" by default), `actions-menu` (the page's header actions as one labelled menu button, absent when the page has none), `import`, `refresh`, or the id of a `headerActions` entry. Under the board look the buttons render in a fixed order whatever the manifest declares: export, actions-menu, other secondary buttons, the buildiq square, then the primary button. Shown only with `showTitle`; when they show, the actions bar drops its Views and Actions menus, and the Add button and Export menu when a button takes their action. Maps to CnIndexPage `headerButtons`. type='reports' (screens-reports-header-buttons, 2.96.0): the same buttons beside the reports page title, as board DcRapportages draws "Downloaden". There `label` is required and `action` is the id of a `headerActions` entry (same shape as on an index page), which says what the click does; every click also emits `header-action`. Under the board look the buildiq square sits between the secondary buttons and the primary one. Maps to CnReportsPage `headerButtons`.

label.description: i18n key; optional for `add`.

run.description: For `export`: the id of a `headerActions` entry the button runs instead of the export dialog. On a named or endpoint source an Export without `run` (and without a mass-export listener) is not drawn (2.127.0).

heading.description: i18n key of a group heading.

items.description: For `actions-menu`: the menu's entries, in order. Each is `header-actions` (every header action), the id of one `headerActions` entry, or a built-in of the actions bar's own menu, which the bar drops while header buttons show: `import`, `export`, `refresh`, `copy-selected`, `delete-selected` (disabled until a row is selected) or `documentation` (a link to the page's documentationUrl, left out without one). An unknown name is left out. Absent: the header actions only (screens-index-header-actions-menu, 2.90.0). Entries can be grouped: `{ "heading": "<i18n key>" }` draws a group heading and `"separator"` a rule, each only when an entry follows it, so a group whose entries are all left out leaves no empty heading (screens-index-header-menu-headings, 2.93.0).

search.description: type='index': `false` draws no inline search in the actions bar, also in the board look, which otherwise draws one on every index page. Wins over `inlineSearch` (2.127.0).

searchRefusalHint.description: type='index': what to do after a refused search, through the app's translate; the default explains AND, OR, NOT and quotes (2.133.0).

searchPlacement.description: type='index', board look: where the search field sits. `toolbar` puts it on row 1 before the Filter button and the view switch instead of opening row 2 (DqTeamwachtrij, 2.127.0).

sortSelectOptions.description: type='index': the orders the index sidebar's Sort section offers in the list, card and map views, `{ value, label, order?, default?, source? }`. An option with a `source` takes its rows from an app endpoint, in that endpoint's order, for an order the server cannot sort by; the page's search, sidebar filters and pager run over those rows in the browser, and it is chosen by its value. `default: true` opens the page on it unless the address carries an order; a column header click in the table view leaves it. When the endpoint fails the list falls back to the option's `order` and shows `failedNote` (2.131.0).

url.description: An app path, resolved with generateUrl and fetched with the session.

params.description: Query parameters sent with the request.

rowsPath.description: Where the entries sit in the answer; `results` by default, a bare array as is.

rowPath.description: Where each entry carries its row; entries without one are left out.

carry.description: Entry fields copied onto each row, such as a tier a card's head pill reads.

idPath.description: The row's identity for `annotate`; `id` by default.

annotate.description: Copy the carried fields onto the rows of every other order too, matched on idPath.

searchFields.description: The fields the search box matches; every top-level text by default.

failedNote.description: Shown above the list when the endpoint failed and the option's order stands in, through the app's translate.

defaultOrder.description: type='index', self-fetch: the order the page opens on when neither the address nor sortKeys gives one: `"-createdAt"`, `"priority:desc,title"`, an `_order` map or a `[{ key, order }]` list (2.127.0).

listConfig.description: type='index': the field mapping of the list view's rows (CnObjectRow): titleField, subtitleField, imageField, iconField, iconName, badgeField and the badge keys stay free-form. 2.127.0 types the row cells and the meta template (DqTeamwachtrij).

subtitleTemplate.description: The meta line: `{field}` tokens filled from the row; empty parts and their separators drop.

width.description: CSS width, lining the column up across rows.

leading.description: One cell before the title, drawn as a table column draws it (`{ key: "createdAt", widget: "age" }`).

trailing.description: A cell, or a list of cells, after the badges, each drawn as a table column draws it.

width.description: CSS width, lining the column up across rows.
CSS width, lining the column up across rows.

rowTitle.description: type='index' (screens-table-rows-parity): how the board look draws the table's title column. `link` (the default) is the 15px weight 600 underlined title of the DqZaken board; `plain` is the 15px bold title without an underline over a 13px muted secondary line, as the PqTickets and OcPublicaties boards draw it. The row stays clickable either way. The Nextcloud look ignores it. Maps to CnIndexPage `rowTitle`.

showTypeEyebrow.description: type='detail': `false` drops the type eyebrow (the type label above the record name) once the record resolves, for a header that says the type in a pill instead (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps). Maps to CnDetailPage `showTypeEyebrow`.

breadcrumb.description: A breadcrumb line. type='detail' (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps): one crumb naming the list the record belongs to (`route` + optional `params`, or `href`); the record's display name follows as the current crumb. Maps to CnDetailPage `breadcrumb`. type='index' | 'dashboard' | 'settings' (page-header-breadcrumb): one crumb or a list, drawn under the title in the same row style; the page title follows as the current crumb. Maps to the page's `breadcrumb`.

headerCard.description: type='detail': draw the header (pills, title, actions) as a bordered card on the surface colour, as the board's case header (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps-2). Maps to CnDetailPage `headerCard`.

headerWidget.description: type='detail': the id of a widget in `widgets` to render inside the header on its own row under the title, without a card of its own, e.g. the stages bars (zuiddrecht-pixel-gaps-2). The widget leaves the body grid. Maps to CnDetailPage `headerWidget`.

visibilityContext.description: type='detail': records the page reads beside the loaded one, so a widget's or a tab's `visibleWhen` can ask about them (detail-widgets-visible-when). `{ <name>: { field, register, schema } }`: `field` is the property of the loaded record holding the other record's id, and a condition reads that record as `@context.<name>.<path>`, e.g. `{ "field": "@context.caseType.category", "op": "in", "value": ["Sociaal domein"] }`. A record that cannot be read is absent, so its condition fails safe. Maps to CnDetailPage `visibilityContext`.

field.description: Dot-path on the loaded record to the id of the record to read.

register.description: Register slug or id of the record to read.

schema.description: Schema slug or id of the record to read.

accessPurpose.description: type='detail': ask why the reader opens the record before the page shows it, and record the answer (detail-access-purpose). `when` is a condition in the visibleWhen grammar on the record and its visibilityContext records; `options` the purposes offered ("Other" with a written purpose is always added); `url` the app endpoint that records the purpose (POST { purpose, note }, {objectId} filled in). Nothing of the record shows until the endpoint accepts; the same record is not asked again in the same browser session. Maps to CnDetailPage `accessPurpose`.

when.description: The condition under which the page asks, e.g. { "field": "@context.caseType.specialDataCategories", "op": "notEmpty" }.

label.description: i18n key.

url.description: App endpoint that records the purpose; {objectId} is filled in.

title.description: i18n key of the dialog's title.

description.description: i18n key of the sentence under the title.

mapConfig.description: type='index': how rows are plotted when the Map view mode is available. Non-empty (and not excluded by an explicit viewModes) adds a Map segment to the view toggle. Maps to CnIndexPage `mapConfig`.

latField.description: Object (or `@self`) property path holding the marker's latitude. Dotted paths are supported, e.g. `@self.geo.lat`.

lngField.description: Object (or `@self`) property path holding the marker's longitude.

geoField.description: Alternative single property holding a GeoJSON Point geometry (`{ type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat] }`). Takes precedence over latField/lngField when present and resolvable.

popupField.description: Object property rendered in the marker popup.

center.description: Fallback centre `[lat, lng]` when the filtered set has no plottable rows.

clustering.description: Whether coincident markers are grouped into a cluster that spiderfies on click. ON by default here — the opposite of CnMapWidget's own default — because an index map plots whatever the filter returns, and several rows at one address is the normal case: unclustered they land on identical pixels, the topmost takes every click and the rest are unreachable with nothing on screen saying they exist. Non-point geometry skips the cluster group, so areas are unaffected. Set false for the old behaviour.

markerColor.description: Colour each marker by a field of its row. Without `source` the value is looked up in `colorMap`; with `source` the field is a reference and the referenced row's `colorField` is the colour, or the key `colorMap` maps to one. A value nothing maps to gets `default`, else the map's own colour.

field.description: The row field (dotted path, also under `@self`).

colorMap.description: Value (or source colour key) to CSS colour; `var(--x, #fallback)` is resolved for the SVG marker.

plotAll.description: Plot every row that matches the filters instead of the current page: `true` for up to 500, or a number. When more rows match, a note under the map says the first N are shown.

count.description: A count line under the map: `true` for "Showing {located} of {total} located", or a template with `{located}` and `{total}` through the app's translate.

quickFilterMaxVisible.description: type='index', chips mode: how many quickFilters render as pills before the rest move behind one more chip — a `⋯` pill that opens a panel of the hidden lenses, and that wears the label and the active fill of whichever one is on. 0 (the default) renders every lens, which wraps the actions bar onto a second line once a page declares more than a handful. The visible set is the FIRST n entries of quickFilters, so reorder that array to change which lenses stay out. Maps to CnIndexPage `quickFilterMaxVisible`.

actionToggles.description: Built-in action toggles for type='index' pages. Each key is sugar for the matching CnIndexPage prop — manifest authors can hide built-in mass actions / row actions / the Add button without writing a wrapper. Mirrors the CnIndexPage prop names. Explicit config.<key> wins over config.actionToggles.<key> (matches the readOnly precedence rule). Distinct from config.actions[] which is the typed row-actions array.

showAdd.description: Whether to show the Add button in the actions bar. Maps to CnIndexPage `showAdd`.

showFormDialog.description: Whether the built-in create / edit form dialog is enabled. Maps to CnIndexPage `showFormDialog`.

showViewAction.description: Whether to add a View action to row actions. Maps to CnIndexPage `showViewAction`.

showEditAction.description: Whether to add an Edit action to row actions. Maps to CnIndexPage `showEditAction`.

showCopyAction.description: Whether to add a Copy action to row actions. Maps to CnIndexPage `showCopyAction`.

showDeleteAction.description: Whether to add a Delete action to row actions. Maps to CnIndexPage `showDeleteAction`.

showMassImport.description: Whether to show the built-in mass Import action. Maps to CnIndexPage `showMassImport`.

showMassExport.description: Whether to show the built-in mass Export action. Maps to CnIndexPage `showMassExport`.

showMassCopy.description: Whether to show the built-in mass Copy button. Maps to CnIndexPage `showMassCopy`.

showMassDelete.description: Whether to show the built-in mass Delete button. Maps to CnIndexPage `showMassDelete`.

showViewToggle.description: Whether to show the table/cards view-mode toggle. Maps to CnIndexPage `showViewToggle`.

selectable.description: Whether rows are selectable (driving the mass-action surface). Maps to CnIndexPage `selectable`.

mode.description: Authoring / access mode. type='form': 'edit' loads from `data`, 'create' starts blank, 'public' shows the public-form success banner and skips auth-state requirements. type='detail': 'public' marks the route as unauthenticated (token-scoped reader pages — pair with a route-param token via the @route.<param> sentinel). Maps to CnFormPage / CnDetailPage `mode` prop.

subscribe.description: Collaborative-editing default for type='detail'. When true (the default) CnDetailPage calls `objectStore.subscribe(objectType, objectId)` on mount via `useObjectSubscription` and unsubscribes on unmount. Set to false for read-only or archive views. Mirrors the `subscribe` Boolean prop on CnDetailPage / CnObjectSidebar. See the `collaborative-editing-defaults` capability.

lock.description: Collaborative-editing default for type='detail'. When true (the default) the page wires `useObjectLock` so the locked-by-other banner renders when a remote lock is active. Explicit lock acquire/release on the edit toggle is the v2 follow-up; at v1 this flag controls whether read-side `lockState` is wired. Mirrors the `lock` Boolean prop on CnDetailPage / CnObjectSidebar.

sidebar.description: Per-page top-level sidebar visibility gate. Sibling of config, applies to every page type. show: boolean gates CnPageRenderer's #sidebar slot.

show.description: Whether the host App's #sidebar slot renders for this page. Defaults to true.

_note.description: Human-readable note. REQUIRED when type is 'custom' — must document why a standard page type was not feasible.

allOf.description: map-image-layer: on a map page an `image` layer is a picture in flat pixel coordinates and needs a url and its width and height in pixels; markers on such a map read xField and yField.

xField.description: Image maps: the row property holding x, in pixels from the picture's left. Default x.

yField.description: Image maps: the row property holding y, in pixels from the picture's top. Default y.

allOf.description: screens-board-reference-columns (2.97.0): config.board on an index page, the block CnPageRenderer hands to CnIndexPage's `board` prop, is typed by boardView like pages[].board.
index-calendar-view-mode: config.calendar on an index page is typed by calendarView.
index-copy-with-relations: config.copy on an index page is typed by copySettings.
index-column-order-and-pinning: config.personalColumns on an index page lets people order and pin columns and keeps the layout per user; false keeps show and hide only.
form-live-values: config.fields[] on a form page may carry assign, a token default and calculate.
form-smart-paste: config.smartPaste on a form page is typed by formSmartPaste.

splitView, manualOrder, savedViewTree, board and dateAxis are index-page mechanics. splitView emits a second route beside an index route and mounts the detail pane inside CnIndexPage; manualOrder holds a per-user row order for a list. Declared on a detail, dashboard or custom page they would validate and then do nothing, which is the failure this branch refuses out loud (case-page-and-list-as-a-place).

The "builtin:<id>" placeholders in config.actions place CnIndexPage's built-in row actions, so only a type='index' page may use them. On every other page type config.actions holds objects only; a placeholder there would validate and then render nothing (row-action-builtin-placement).

tabInAddress puts the active tab of a record in the address. Only a detail page has a record and a tab strip, so the key is refused elsewhere rather than validating into a no-op (case-page-and-list-as-a-place).

type='wiki' (CnWikiPage) renders one manifest-declared markdown article. It MUST declare both config.register and config.schema as non-empty strings so the manifest stays the source of truth for which OpenRegister register/schema the article body is read from (manifest-wiki-page-type).

type='links' (CnLinkCardsPage) renders config.cards as link cards grouped by config.categories. It MUST declare a non-empty cards list, and every card is a $defs/linkCard, so a card that can go nowhere is refused here and not dropped in silence at render time (link-cards-page).

modules.description: Module cards drawn above the link cards (board PqModules): per module an icon, title, in-the-menu/off badge, description, its pages, an Open button and, when off, a link to the admin settings.

modulesTitle.description: i18n key / heading of the modules section. Defaults to 'Modules'.

footnote.description: i18n key / a note under the module cards.

groupStyle.description: cards: a grid of link cards per group. list: one card per group with a row per link (icon, label, description, chevron or external-link icon).

allOf.description: type='custom' requires _note documenting why decomposition into a standard page type was not feasible. Relaxed by ConductionNL/nextcloud-vue#315: when `component` matches the lib `Cn[A-Z]\w+` pattern, the component name already documents the choice and _note is optional. When `component` is absent or non-Cn (host-app SFC), _note remains required.

then.description: Lib-SFC custom page: component is self-documenting, _note is optional.

else.description: Host-app SFC custom page (or no component): _note is required to document why a standard page type was not feasible.

visibleIfCondition.description: A visibleIf condition block. Each key is either a reserved specialised condition (appInstalled) or a dot-separated path into manifest.runtime. Values are predicate expressions (scalar for eq shorthand, or operator object). All conditions are combined with implicit AND.

appInstalled.description: Nextcloud app id that MUST be installed and enabled for this entry to render.

deepLink.description: ADR-040 object deep-link descriptor. Maps an OR register+schema to an in-app URL template so other apps / the integration registry can resolve a deep link to an object. Permissive: extra keys are tolerated for forward-compatibility.

registerSlug.description: OR register slug the deep link targets.

schemaSlug.description: OR schema slug the deep link targets.

urlTemplate.description: In-app URL template; {uuid} (and other object placeholders) are substituted at resolve time.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for the linked object type.

adminSettingsEntry.description: One admin-only settings section rendered by CnAppRoot's generic admin NcAppSettingsDialog, sorted into the dialog by `order`. Exactly one of `type` (a built-in section) or `component` (a custom section resolved from the renderer registry) MUST be present.

id.description: Unique identifier for this admin-settings entry; also the rendered NcAppSettingsSection id.

label.description: i18n translation key (English source) resolved by the consuming app's t() function, shown as the section header.

type.description: Built-in admin-settings section. Closed enum. 'organisation-credentials' renders CnCredentials with scope="organisation" (the OpenRegister credential broker's organisation-scope pane). Mutually exclusive with `component`.

component.description: Registry key of a custom admin-settings section component, resolved from the CnAppRoot custom-components registry at render time. Mutually exclusive with `type`.

order.description: Sort order of this section within the admin dialog. Entries without an order render last, in array position.

permission.description: Optional permission string that further narrows visibility of this section WITHIN the already owner-gated admin dialog, reusing the existing per-item permission grammar. Narrow-only: it can never widen access to a caller who is not an owner of the app.

props.description: Props forwarded to a custom `component` entry. Ignored for built-in `type` entries.
